ཀྱཻ: O! a call for attention (also written kye)
རིགས་ཀྱི་བུ: child of the family, child of noble family (rigs 'family' + kyi 'of' + bu 'son, child'; Sanskrit kulaputra)
ནས: from; after a verb: 'having done, and then'
ན: if, when (after the verb); also 'in, at' · to be ill, sickness (na, the verb of na ba): skye rga na 'chi 'birth, ageing, sickness and death'
དང: and; with · after a verb: 'as soon as' (brgyal bsangs pa dang 'as soon as the faint has cleared')
ཞི་བ: peaceful (zhi ba); the peaceful ones, the peaceful deities, as against khro bo, the wrathful
ཆུ་སྲིན: water monster, the makara (chu 'water' + srin 'monster'), a sea creature like a crocodile
པདྨ: lotus (Sanskrit padma, written with stacked letters; said 'pema'). Here the Lotus family, the deities grouped around Amitābha · the flower itself, as an emblem held in the hand: phyag na padma bsnams pa 'holding a lotus in the hand'
རྡོ་རྗེ: vajra, the diamond-thunderbolt held by deities, emblem of what cannot be broken (rdo rje)
གི: of (the form used after g, ng); in this print also written where gis 'by' is meant · after a verb: 'and', running on to what follows ('ong gi 'comes, and')
ཐོད་ཁྲག: skull and blood, a skull cup full of blood (thod 'skull' + khrag 'blood')
རྣལ་འབྱོར: yoga; here a yogin, a practitioner (rnal 'the natural state' + 'byor 'to join')
ནང: inside, within (nang): 'od kyi nang nas 'from within the light'
ལ: to, at, in, for; after a verb or adjective: 'and' · among (… kyi rigs la 'among those of the … kind') · on (… la bzhugs 'seated on …') · from, of, with verbs of fleeing and fearing (X la bros 'flee from X')
འཆར་དུ: to dawn, to arise ('char 'dawn, arise' + -du 'to'): 'char du 'ong 'will dawn'
དེ: that; he, it. After a verb (also te, ste): 'and then'
མ: not (before past and imperative verbs) · in a prohibition also before the present stem: ma byed cig 'do not do!' · mother (ma): ma dang bu 'mother and child'
འཇིགས་ཤིག: be afraid! ('jigs 'fear' + shig, which marks a command); ma 'jigs shig 'do not be afraid'
འགེངས་པ: filling, drawing (a bow) ('gengs, the present stem of the verb whose past is bkang, + -pa)
འཛིན་པ: grasping, holding ('dzin 'hold' + -pa): the mind taking hold of what it sees · holding with compassion (thugs rjes 'dzin pa)
ཀྱི: of (the form used after d, b, s; also gyi, gi, -'i, yi) · in this print perhaps also written where kyis 'by' is meant (khyod kyi gong du, read as khyod kyis)
རྣལ་འབྱོར་མ: yoginī (rnal 'byor ma, the feminine of rnal 'byor pa 'yogin'): the Īśvarīs are also called yoginīs
གྱི: of (the form used after n, m, r, l) · after a verb: 'but', marking a contrast (yin gyi 'it is so, but') · in this print perhaps also written where gyis 'by, with' is meant (dmar gyi bkang 'filled with red')
ཤིང: and, while (links two verbs; also cing, zhing)
ཤར: arisen, appeared (shar, past of 'char 'arise') · the east (shar): dkyil 'khor de'i shar nas 'from the east of that maṇḍala'
ལྕགས་ཀྱུ: iron hook (lcags 'iron' + kyu 'hook'): the hook by which the light of compassion draws one out
ཡང: also, even, though (written kyang after g, d, b, s) · again, once more, at the head of a sentence (yang ngo sprad pa ni 'and the pointing out again')
དབང་ཕྱུག་མ: Īśvarī, 'Lady' (dbang phyug 'lord', Sanskrit īśvara, + -ma, feminine): the goddesses who come last in the host of the wrathful deities
ཉི་ཤུ་རྩ་བརྒྱད: twenty-eight (nyi shu 'twenty' + rtsa, which joins the units to the tens, + brgyad 'eight')
ཧེ་རུ་ཀ: heruka, a blood-drinking wrathful deity (Sanskrit heruka, written in Tibetan letters)
དྲག་པོའི: of the fierce, of the strong (drag po 'fierce' + -'i 'of')
རང་བྱུང: self-arisen, arising of itself (rang 'self' + byung, past of 'byung 'arise, come about')
ལས: from, out of · karma, action (las): las kyi 'of karma'; after a verb or noun, 'other than, of, from among'
རང་ཤར: arisen of itself, self-arisen (rang 'self' + shar, past of 'char 'arise')
ངོ: face; the nature or identity of a thing
གྱིས་ཤིག: do! (gyis, imperative of byed 'do', + shig, which marks a command)
ཆོས་སྐུ: the body of truth, a buddha as reality itself, without form (chos + sku 'body'; Sanskrit dharmakāya)
ཆ: part, share, proportion (cha): yab kyi cha 'the father's part'
གསལ་བའི: making clear, of clarity (gsal ba 'clear, to be clear' + -'i 'of')
ཁྲག་འཐུང: blood-drinker, blood-drinking: the name of the wrathful deities (khrag 'blood' + 'thung, the present stem of 'to drink', past 'thungs; Sanskrit heruka)
ལྔ་བཅུ་རྩ་བརྒྱད: fifty-eight (lnga bcu 'fifty' + rtsa, which joins the units to the tens, + brgyad 'eight')
འཆར་བའི: of dawning, when it dawns ('char ba 'to dawn' + -'i 'of')
འདིར: here, in this ('di + -r 'in') · in 'dir btsam du, as printed, perhaps for ldir 'roaring' (ldir ba tsam du 'as loud as the roaring of'); a guess
རང་མདངས: own radiance, natural glow (rang 'self' + mdangs 'radiance, glow')
ཤེས: to know, to recognise (shes); ngo shes 'recognise, know the face'
གཉིས་སུ: into two, as two (gnyis 'two' + -su): gnyis su med par 'without being two, non-dually'
ཁྱེད: you (khyed), the politer word, also used for more than one: khyed rnams 'you all'
རྣམས: plural marker, set after the noun and its adjectives
ཅིང: and, while (links two verbs; also shing, zhing)
རང་སྣང: self-appearance, one's own appearance (rang 'self' + snang 'appear'): what the mind itself shows
འཁོར་བར: in saṃsāra, in the round ('khor ba 'the round, saṃsāra' + -r 'in')
སྐྲག: to be frightened, to be terrified (skrag); fright
མི: not (before present and future verbs) · person, human being (mi): 'dris pa'i mi 'a person one has known'
ཁྲོ་བོའི: of the wrathful ones, wrathful (khro bo 'wrathful one' + -'i 'of')
ཀྱང: also, even, though (the form of yang after g, d, b, s)
ནི: as for: marks the topic of the sentence
ཙམ་པ: about the size of, as much as (tsam 'as much as' + -pa)
ཐ་མ: lowest, last (tha ma): tha ma'i yang tha ma 'the lowest even of the lowest'
ཙམ: just, only, about · as much as, so much that (tsam): mgo 'gas pa tsam 'so loud as to split the head'
འབྱུང་བས: because it happens, since it comes about ('byung 'occur' + -bas, the print's spelling of -pas 'because')
སྐྲག་ཅིག: be frightened! (skrag + cig, which marks a command); ma skrag cig 'do not be frightened'
སྐུ་རུ: as bodies, as divine forms (sku 'body', the respectful word, + -ru 'as')
སྣང་བ: appearance, what appears to the senses or the mind; light
ཤེས་པས: because of knowing (shes pa 'knowing' + -s 'because'): ma shes pas 'because you did not know'
བུ: child, son (bu): ma dang bu 'mother and child'
བྱུང: came about, happened, occurred (byung, past of 'byung)
འོད་གསལ: clear light, luminosity: the nature of mind, said to show itself bare at death ('od 'light' + gsal 'clear')
གཅིག: one; a, a certain · perhaps 'together, at once' (as gcig 'one' in 'od drug kyang gcig 'char du 'ong 'the six lights also dawn together'); the sense is not sure
གིས: by (the form used after g, ng) · after a verb: 'and', running on to what follows, as gi does ('ong gis 'comes, and')
བྱ་བ: called; what is to be done (bya, future of byed 'do', + ba). zhes bya ba: 'so called'
འབྱུང་བ: element, one of the five of which the world is made: earth, water, fire, wind, space ('byung ba, literally 'what arises') · arising, coming about ('byung 'arise' + -ba)
འཁྱམ་མོ: wanders ('khyam, a form of 'khyams 'wander', + the sentence-ending -mo)
མདོ་རྒྱུད: sūtras and tantras (mdo 'sūtra' + rgyud 'tantra'): the Buddha's word
ཆོས: thing, phenomenon; the teaching (Sanskrit dharma) · reality, what is true (chos): chos kyi rang sgra 'the own sound of reality'
བྱས: did, made, having done (byas, past of byed 'do')
གནད: vital point, key point (gnad): the place where a thing is decided, like a pressure point on the body
མ་ཐག་ཏུ: as soon as, immediately after (ma 'not' + thag 'distance' + -tu: 'with no interval'): after a verb
ཆོས་ཉིད: reality itself, the true nature of things (chos 'thing' + nyid 'itself'; Sanskrit dharmatā)
བར་དོར: in the bardo (bar do + -r 'in, into') · as the bardo: the -r marks what a thing is recognised as (bar dor ngo shes 'recognise as the bardo')
གྱིས: do! (imperative of byed 'to do'); spelled the same as gyis 'by' · by (the 'by' ending as a free word after n, m, r, l): las bzang ngan gyis 'by good or bad karma'
འཇིག་རྟེན: the world ('jig 'perish' + rten 'support': the perishable support)
ཁམས: realm, world, element (khams): 'jig rten gyi khams 'the realms of the world'
ཡོད་པ: having, there being; one who has (yod 'there is' + -pa)
ཁ: mouth (kha); in ro kha khye, as printed, perhaps for ro khar khyer 'carries a corpse to the mouth' (uncertain)
སྒྲོག་པ: crying out, sounding (sgrog, the present stem of sgrog 'to proclaim, cry aloud' (past bsgrags), + -pa)
སྐྲག་པར: being frightened, to be frightened (skrag pa 'fright' + -r); ma skrag par 'without fear'
བྱེད་ཅིག: do (byed, the present stem of byed 'do', + cig, which marks a command): with ma, a prohibition, ma byed cig 'do not do!' (the imperative of byed is gyis)
བག་ཆགས: habitual tendencies, the traces past actions leave in the mind (bag chags; Sanskrit vāsanā)
འཆི་རྒྱུ: something to die, an occasion for dying ('chi 'die' + rgyu 'cause, occasion')
དོན: meaning, point, matter; a heading or part of a text
གྲུབ་པ: established, proved to exist (grub 'be established' + -pa); ma grub pa 'not established as anything' · formed, made (… las grub pa 'formed from …'); accomplished (grub 'be accomplished' + -pa)
ཀྱིས: by, by means of (the 'of' particle + -s; the form used after d, b, s) · after a verb: 'but, and', running on to what follows (yod kyis 'there is, but') · in this print also written where kyi 'of' is meant (sangs rgyas kyis sku, read 'the buddha's bodies')
གླགས: opportunity, chance (glags): bzod glags med pa 'with no chance to bear it', unbearable
རང་རྩལ: own energy, natural play (rang 'self' + rtsal 'skill, power'): what awareness shows of itself
མགོ་བརྙན: head-likeness, a head in the shape of an animal's (mgo 'head' + brnyan 'image, likeness')
གཤིན་རྗེའི: of the Lord of Death, Yama (gshin rje 'lord of the dead' + -'i 'of')
གཟུགས: form, the body and all that can be seen (gzugs): the first of the five aggregates
ལ་སོགས: and so on, etcetera (la sogs: la 'to' + sogs 'et cetera')
གྲོལ: to be freed, to come free
སངས་རྒྱས་པར: to being a buddha, as a buddha (sangs rgyas 'buddha' + -pa + -r 'to'): sangs rgyas par 'gyur 'become a buddha'
འགྱུར་རོ: becomes, will become ('gyur 'to become, to change' + the sentence-ending -ro)
འཕྲང: narrow passage, defile, a dangerous place on a road ('phrang)
བསུ་བ: meeting, welcoming, going out to meet someone (bsu 'to meet, welcome' + -ba); bsu ba la 'ongs 'come to meet'
སྐྱབས་སུ: for refuge, as refuge (skyabs 'refuge' + -su 'to'): skyabs su mchi'o 'I go for refuge'
མཆིའོ: I go (mchi, the humble 'go', + the sentence-ending -'o)
དུང་དུང: longingly, ardently (dung dung, a doubled word akin to gdung 'to long for')
མཛོད་ཅིག: please do! (mdzod, respectful 'do!' + cig, which marks a command)
དཀོན་མཆོག་གསུམ: the Three Jewels: the Buddha, the teaching and the community (dkon 'rare' + mchog 'supreme' + gsum 'three')
ར་མདའ: help, rescue (ra mda' sbran: 'to call for help')
རིན་པོ་ཆེ: precious, a precious thing, jewel (rin 'value' + po + che 'great')
ཞེས: so, thus: closes a quotation or a name (like inverted commas)
གསོལ་བ: prayer, request, asking (gsol ba) · the respectful word for eating and drinking: zhal du gsol ba 'putting to the mouth, eating, drinking'
ཐོབ་ཅིག: uncertain; perhaps 'obtain!' (thob 'obtain, get' + cig, which marks a command); gsol ba thob cig gives no clear sense, and is read, as a guess, 'make the prayer'
